## What is SRLU?

**SRLU | Skyrim Level-Up!** brings the iconic Skyrim level-up sound to World of Warcraft! Experience that epic, triumphant chime every time you level up — no more bland default sounds. Whether you're a veteran Dragonborn or new to Skyrim, this addon brings that satisfying level-up feeling to your WoW adventures.

### Why Choose SRLU?
- **Epic Sound:** The authentic Skyrim level-up chime in high, medium, and low quality
- **Multi-Version:** Works across Classic Era, Burning Crusade Classic, Mists, and Retail
- **Multi-Language:** Supports all 12 WoW client languages with automatic detection
- **Smart Muting:** Auto-mutes WoW's default level-up sound
- **Active Support:** Join our Discord for instant help!

---

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Epic Sound** | Iconic Skyrim level-up chime plays on every level gained |
| **Quality Options** | High, Medium, and Low quality sound variants |
| **Easy Commands** | Simple `/srlu` slash command interface |
| **Persistent Settings** | Settings saved automatically between sessions |
| **Multi-Language** | All 12 WoW client languages supported with automatic detection |
| **Smart Muting** | Auto-mutes WoW's default level-up sound |
| **Optimized** | Cached constants for maximum performance |
| **Error Protected** | pcall error handling throughout |
| **Multi-Version** | Works on supported WoW versions |

---

## Language Support

SRLU automatically detects your game language:

| Language | Status | Language | Status |
|----------|--------|----------|--------|
| **English (enUS)** | Supported | **German (deDE)** | Supported |
| **Spanish (esES)** | Supported | **Spanish (LatAm, esMX)** | Supported |
| **French (frFR)** | Supported | **Italian (itIT)** | Supported |
| **Korean (koKR)** | Supported | **Portuguese (Brazil, ptBR)** | Supported |
| **Portuguese (Portugal, ptPT)** | Supported | **Russian (ruRU)** | Supported |
| **Chinese (Simplified, zhCN)** | Supported | **Chinese (Traditional, zhTW)** | Supported |

---

## Quick Start

1. **Install** SRLU from your preferred platform
2. **Launch** World of Warcraft
3. **Enable** SRLU in your AddOns menu
4. **Type** `/srlu help` to get started!
5. **Level up** and hear the Skyrim magic!

---

## Command Reference

Use `/srlu` followed by:

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/srlu help` | Show all available commands |
| `/srlu test` | Play test sound |
| `/srlu enable` | Enable the addon |
| `/srlu disable` | Disable the addon |
| `/srlu high` | Use high quality sound |
| `/srlu med` | Use medium quality sound (default) |
| `/srlu low` | Use low quality sound |

---

## Compatibility

| WoW Version | Interface | Status |
|-------------|-----------|--------|
| **Midnight (Retail)** | `120100` | Fully Supported |
| **WoW Forever (Beta)** | `16001` | Fully Supported |
| **Mists of Pandaria Classic** | `50504` | Fully Supported |
| **Cataclysm Classic** | `40402` | Fully Supported |
| **Wrath of the Lich King Classic** | `38002` | Fully Supported |
| **Burning Crusade Classic** | `20506` | Fully Supported |
| **Classic Era** | `11509` | Fully Supported |

**Required Dependency:** [RGX-Framework](https://github.com/RGXMods/RGX-Framework) must be installed and enabled.

---

## Installation

1. **Download** from your preferred platform:
   - [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/srlu)
   - [Wago.io](https://addons.wago.io/addons/srlu)
   - [GitHub](https://github.com/RGXMods/SkyrimLevelUp/releases)

2. **Extract** to your WoW AddOns directory:
   - **Retail**: `World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns`
   - **Classic**: `World of Warcraft/_classic_/Interface/AddOns`
   - **Classic Era**: `World of Warcraft/_classic_era_/Interface/AddOns`

3. **Restart** WoW and enable in AddOns menu

---

## What's New

_See [docs/CHANGES.md](https://github.com/RGXMods/SkyrimLevelUp/blob/main/docs/CHANGES.md) for the full release history and latest updates._

---

## Configuration Tips

### Default Settings:

| Setting | Default | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `enabled` | `true` | Addon active state |
| `soundVariant` | `medium` | Sound quality setting |
| `muteDefault` | `true` | Mute WoW's default sound |
| `showWelcome` | `true` | Show welcome message |
| `volume` | `Master` | Volume channel used |

### Recommended Setup:
- **First Launch:** Try `/srlu test` to verify sound is working
- **Quality:** Use `high` for the most authentic Skyrim experience
- **Volume:** If the sound is too loud, switch to `med` or `low`
- **Muting:** `muteDefault` is enabled by default to prevent double sounds

---

## Known Issues

- No known issues at this time. Report any problems via [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RGXMods/SkyrimLevelUp/issues) or our [Discord](https://discord.gg/N7kdKAHVVF).

---

## Troubleshooting

**No sound playing?**
- Run `/srlu test` to verify the addon is active and sound is working
- Check that your in-game Master volume is not muted
- Confirm the addon is enabled with `/srlu enable`

**Wrong language?**
- The addon auto-detects your WoW client language. If it's incorrect, check your WoW language settings

**Settings not saving?**
- Ensure WoW has write permissions to its SavedVariables folder
- `/reload` can sometimes resolve settings persistence issues

**Still having trouble?**
- Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/N7kdKAHVVF) for instant support
- Open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/RGXMods/SkyrimLevelUp/issues)

---

## v3.0.7 - 2026-11-05

- Fixed WoW Forever: the base TOC now declares Interface 16001, which is what the Forever client reads, so the addon loads as compatible instead of out of date.
- Removed the unused _Forever.toc file.

# Non-beta Candidate: [v3.0.6](https://github.com/RGXMods/SkyrimLevelUp/blob/main/changelogs/3.0.6.md)

Retail 12.1.5 / Interface `120105`; client testing and publication pending.

# v3.0.5 - 2026-09-27

# Non-beta Candidate: [v3.0.6](https://github.com/RGXMods/SkyrimLevelUp/blob/main/changelogs/3.0.6.md)

Retail 12.1.5 / Interface `120105`; client testing and publication pending.

# v3.0.5 - 2026-09-27

## Changes
- TOC set now covers every active WoW flavor: Retail 120100, Classic Era 11509, TBC 20506, Wrath 38002, Cataclysm 40402, Mists 50504, and WoW Forever 16001. The base TOC claims 120100,16001 so the Forever beta loads without the out-of-date flag.
- Added missing flavor TOCs: SkyrimLevelUp_Vanilla.toc, SkyrimLevelUp_TBC.toc, SkyrimLevelUp_Wrath.toc, SkyrimLevelUp_Cata.toc, SkyrimLevelUp_Mists.toc, SkyrimLevelUp_Forever.toc.
- Aligned the version (3.0.5) across all TOCs and ADDON_VERSION in data/core.lua.

# v3.0.3 - 2026-08-07

## Changes
- TOC bump: Updated universal interface versions to 11509 (Classic Era), 20506 (TBC Anniversary), 50504 (MoP Classic), 120007 (Retail). Removed Cata (40402) and legacy Retail eras (110207, 120000, 120001).

# v3.0.2 - 2026-06-30

## Changes

- Updated for WoW Retail 12.0.7 (Interface 120007).

# v3.0.0 - 2026-04-30

## Changes

- **Migrated to RGX-Framework**: Added `RequiredDeps: RGX-Framework` to TOC. Core logic now uses `RGX:GetSound()`, `RGX:RegisterEvent()`, and `RGX:RegisterSlashCommand()` â€” eliminating duplicated boilerplate.
- **RGXSound handle**: Sound playback, variant management, mute/unmute, settings, and welcome message are now handled by the RGXSound module in RGX-Framework.
